devdoc.details: Balancer Vault: 0xBA12222222228d8Ba445958a75a0704d566BF2C8       (Ethereum mainnet, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism — same address)       THIS IS A TEMPLATE. Audit thoroughly, test on a forked network,       and understand all risks before deploying with real funds.

params.routerA: DEX router for the buy leg  (tokenA → tokenB).
params.routerB: DEX router for the sell leg (tokenB → tokenA).

returns.expectedProfit: Gross profit in tokenA units (before gas costs).

params._balancerVault: Balancer V2 Vault address.                        Use 0xBA12222222228d8Ba445958a75a0704d566BF2C8                        on Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, and Optimism.

params.loanAmount: Amount of tokenA to borrow from the Balancer Vault.
params.routerA: DEX router for leg 1  (tokenA → tokenB, buy leg).
params.routerB: DEX router for leg 2  (tokenB → tokenA, sell leg).
params.tokenA: Token to borrow and end up with (base token).
params.tokenB: Intermediate token used across both swap legs.

receiveFlashLoan(address[],uint256[],uin.details: Must push tokens[i] + feeAmounts[i] back to the Vault before         returning.  On Balancer V2 feeAmounts are always 0, so         repayAmount == loanAmount exactly.

params.feeAmounts: Fee array — currently always 0 on Balancer V2.

params.amount: Amount to withdraw; pass 0 to withdraw the full balance.
params.token: Address of the token to withdraw.

@title  CryptoArbitrageBot
 @notice Flash-loan-powered arbitrage across two Uniswap-V2-compatible DEXes,
         using the Balancer V2 Vault as the zero-fee flash-loan provider.
 ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │  FLOW                                                        │
 │  1. Owner calls executeArbitrage()                           │
 │  2. Contract requests a flash loan from the Balancer Vault   │
 │  3. Vault sends tokenA and calls receiveFlashLoan()          │
 │  4. Swap tokenA → tokenB on dexA (buy leg  — cheaper price) │
 │  5. Swap tokenB → tokenA on dexB (sell leg — higher price)  │
 │  6. Repay exact loanAmount to Vault (Balancer fee = 0)       │
 │  7. Profit stays in this contract                            │
 │  8. Owner calls withdrawToken() to collect profit            │
 └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
